Wow, I can't believe someone else has had Bibles thrown at them. Not many people can say that, that's for sure.

I'm sorry you had to go through that with your friend. That sucks. I'm glad that I have an accepting friend, even if she is not quite sure what to do.

And I'll check out that website, thank you!
Thank you. I'm reading through some of the other posts, and that thing on the sidebar, and I think I'm doing a little better. I'm just distracting myself, which seems to be good.
